description: Improve plan stage artifact generation reliability by adopting structured prompts inspired by OPSX propose

tasks.title: Create template skeleton files for all artifacts
tasks.description: Create `src/agents/prompts/artifacts/templates/` directory with 4 template files: proposal.tpl.md, specs.tpl.md, design.tpl.md, tasks.tpl.md. Each template is a skeleton that the agent fills in — matching the expected output format. Tasks template includes the full JSON structure with placeholder fields.
acceptanceCriteria: tasks.tpl.md contains the JSON structure skeleton matching TasksFile schema

tasks.title: Refactor buildArtifactPrompt() to generate structured prompts
tasks.description: Modify `src/agents/artifact-prompt.ts` buildArtifactPrompt() to generate prompts with XML-tagged sections: <task>, <dependencies>, <output>, <template>, <instruction>. Load the template skeleton from templates/ directory. Build <dependencies> by checking which artifact files exist in changeDir. Define output file path per artifact type.
acceptanceCriteria: <dependencies> only lists files that exist in changeDir
Each artifact type has correct output file mapping: proposal→proposal.md, specs→specs/, design→design.md, tasks→tasks.json
Existing buildSelfReviewPrompt() and buildReviewerPrompt() still work
tasks.notes: Reference OPSX propose.ts for the prompt structure pattern. Keep existing .md instruction files, they go into <instruction> section.

tasks.title: Add per-round retry logic in workflow-controller
tasks.description: Modify `src/workflow/workflow-controller.ts` runPlanStage(): after verify() fails for any round, send a concise retry prompt that explicitly instructs the agent to write the missing file using write_file tool. Only retry once. If retry also fails, close connection and return failure.
acceptanceCriteria: After verify() returns false, a retry prompt is sent to the same ACP connection
Retry prompt explicitly names the missing file path
Retry prompt instructs agent to use write_file tool
Only one retry attempt per round
If retry verify() passes, pipeline continues normally
If retry verify() fails, connection closes and stage returns failure
tasks.notes: Keep existing verify() logic. The retry prompt should be short and focused — not the full artifact prompt again.
